'''JMulTi''' is an [[open-source software|open-source]] interactive [[software]] for [[econometric analysis]], specialised in univariate and multivariate [[time series]] analysis. It has a [[Java (programming language)|Java]] [[graphical user interface]].

The motivation for its designed was to provide the means by which some time-series econometric procedures that were difficult or unavailable in other packages could be undertaken. Such procedures include Impulse Response Analysis with bootstrapped confidence intervals for [[Vector autoregression|VAR]]/[[VECM|VEC]] modelling.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.jmulti.com/ |title=Home |website=jmulti.com}}</ref>
